title: Interlinkage: Mineral Resources & Agricultural Development
subject: Geography
topic: Interlinkage between Mineral Resources and Agricultural Development
description: A flowchart illustrating the critical interlinkages between mineral resources and agricultural development in India, highlighting how minerals like phosphate rock and limestone are used as agricultural inputs, along with associated environmental concerns and strategic initiatives.
mermaidCode: graph TD A[Mineral Resources] --> B{Input for Agriculture} B --> C[Phosphate Rock Mining] C --> C1[Production of DAP Fertilizer] C1 --> C2[~35% India's Fertilizer Consumption] C --> C3(Mainly Jharkhand, MP) B --> D[Limestone Mining] D --> D1[Production of Agricultural Lime] D1 --> D2[Neutralises Acidic Soils (Gangetic Plains)] B --> E[Environmental Concerns] E --> E1[Fly Ash Contamination] E --> E2[Tailings Contamination] E1 & E2 --> E3(Contaminate Irrigation Water) F[Strategic Initiatives] --> F1[National Mineral Exploration Programme (NMEP)] F --> F2[Soil Health Card Scheme] F1 & F2 --> F3(Align Mineral Extraction with Sustainable Agronomy)
